pages.text: Create 6.0.10 has $(l)no survival recipe$() for Chromatic Compound, Refined Radiance or Shadow Steel. This mod adds one for each, so the chain is playable.$(br2)A modpack that already makes them can override these recipe ids with a datapack.
pages.title: Added by this mod

pages.text: One compound costs: $(li)1 Polished Rose Quartz$(li)5 Precision Mechanism$(li)5 Electron Tube$(li)2500 mB lava
$(l)Sequenced assembly$() on a $(item)Polished Rose Quartz$(), 5 loops of:$(li)deploy Precision Mechanism$(li)deploy Electron Tube$(li)fill 500 mB lava$(li)press
$(l)Superheated mixing$(): 1 Chromatic Compound, 4 Glowstone Dust, 2 Amethyst Shard. One per batch.
$(l)Superheated mixing$(): 1 Chromatic Compound, 2 Obsidian, 1 Ender Pearl. One per batch.
